name: PitchReel — Resume Video Introduction (Explainer & Presenter, Short / Standard / Full)
description:
Can I turn my resume into a 60-second vertical video introduction, cut only from my own resume?
How it works:
1. Upload your resume on our site.
2. We draft a narration script from it — every figure quoted word-for-word from your resume. Nothing is invented.
3. You review and edit every line, then lock the script. Only then do you pay.
4. We produce your film: one sentence per screen, your numbers as animated highlights, pro voiceover, delivered as a 1080x1920 MP4.
This product is the Standard Explainer cut (~60 seconds, no photo). Pay here with your PitchReel order reference so we can match your payment to your order.

hasMerchantReturnPolicy.description: If we make a mistake (a misread line, a wrong number, a wrong cut, or a broken file), we fix it and re-render free of charge. If we cannot fix it, we refund in full. Orders cancelled before production starts are refunded in full via Gumroad. Email support@newkwlab.com.

additionalProperty.name: delivery
additionalProperty.value: Service delivery, not a file download. You review and lock your script on the PitchReel site before paying; the finished film is produced after payment and delivered as an MP4 via your PitchReel result page and email.

additionalProperty.name: requirements
additionalProperty.value: A current resume (for the script) and, for the Presenter/Photo version, one clear photo of yourself. Payment is matched to your order via your PitchReel order reference.
